newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore bunker final report and prices - Sept 17.
newsitem.headline: Singapore bunker final report and prices - Sept 17.

text.p: DELIVERED U.S.$/TONNE) 380 CST 180 CST MDO GAS OIL

COMMENTS - Singapore bunker prices on Tuesday were lower as more sellers emerged to meet buyers requirement, traders said. Bunker 180-cst was traded at $117.50 while 380-cst at $112, traders said. "More demand was seen today after sellers moved levels lower," a major said. MDO was lower at $205-$210 and gas oil at around $220-$225. -Singapore Newsroom (+65-8703082).
